The course will be delivered asynchronously, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Modules are structured to guide students through the content, with quizzes and small projects to assess understanding. Support will be provided through Canvas Discussion or email.

This course invites students into the world of Python, a highly regarded programming language with extensive applications in data analysis, automation, and machine learning within diverse business contexts. Requiring no previous programming knowledge, the course is designed to impart a beginner level understanding of Python, its syntax, its setup and navigation protocols, and its significance in the business landscape. It enables students to engage with Python scripts, interpret the output (including standard error messages), and grasp the structure and syntax of straightforward Python scripts. Upon course completion, students will gain the ability to enact simple yet significant modifications to existing scripts, enhancing their ability to leverage Python in their business studies and careers.

Module 1: Python A New Language for Business - Understanding Python's role in business.
Module 2: The rules of Python: Writing Sequential Instructions - Writing and interpreting Python code.
Module 3: The ABCs of Python: Integers, Strings, and Booleans - Playing with basic data types and functions.
Module 4: Build Simple Functions - Crafting functions for business problems.
Module 5: Create a Simple Module - Develop and utilize a custom calculator module.
Module 6: Introduce Online Libraries - Experiment with QR code libraries.
Module 7: Setup and Navigate the Python Environment - Installing and Implement Python locally.
Final Assessments: Course Quiz and Course Final Project
